subject: MAP onboarding & technical handoff for DataProtect — next steps
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amit Shah <amit@dataprotect.io>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@dataprotect.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP onboarding & technical handoff for DataProtect — next steps

Hi Amit / Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to kick off the Mutual Action Plan and get the evaluation moving. I want to introduce the technical leads who will run the POC and unblock DataProtect during the evaluation window:

- Marcus Lin (Solutions Engineer, Redwood) — will own integration, test harness, and infra questions.
- Rishi Malhotra (ML Engineer, Redwood) — will advise on model selection, quantization guidance, and evaluation metrics.

Proposed MAP summary / near-term timeline (high level):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm success criteria + access (S3 test bucket, sample prompt set).
- Week 1: Environment setup + simple inference smoke tests.
- Week 2: Full evaluation run (throughput/latency, cost per token, qualitative checks).
- Week 3: Results review & decision meeting — aim to agree on next steps and close timeline.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm the primary technical contact for DataProtect (if not Amit/Sofia).
2) Provide a minimal test dataset and an example prompt list (redact PII if needed).
3) Confirm whether the test environment can accept inbound connections from our IPs — I attached a short network checklist.

Attachments: [Attachment: 20260802-DP-MAP-v1.docx (docx)], [Attachment: network_access_checklist.csv (csv)]

I’ll schedule a 30-minute MAP kickoff sync for Wednesday — invites to follow. Marcus / Rishi: feel free to add anything on the tech side.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0142

-----Original Message-----
On Mon, 2 Aug 2026 at 10:05 AM, Amit Shah <amit@dataprotect.io> wrote:
> Hi Camila, Marcus, Rishi —
>
> Thanks for the intro and the clear plan. Sofia and I are aligned on the timeline but want to include our engineering lead, Priya Kothari, for the technical kickoff. She’ll need to confirm network access windows and the S3 location. Copying her on the next email once I have her available times.
>
> A couple quick notes from our side:
> - We can provide a sanitized sample dataset by tomorrow evening PST.
> - We prefer the evaluation to include a 95th percentile latency target (sub-300ms) and an accuracy checklist tied to our business-critical prompt set.
>
> Can Marcus / Rishi confirm the expected data format and any constraints on prompt length?
>
> Best,
> Amit Shah
> Sr. Engineering Manager — Data Products, DataProtect
> amit@dataprotect.io


-----Original Message-----
On Mon, 2 Aug 2026 at 12:18 PM, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Hi Amit / Sofia / Camila —
>
> Great to meet you virtually. Quick answers to Amit’s technical questions and what we’ll need to get started:
>
> Expected data / prompt guidelines:
> - We can accept JSONL or newline-delimited CSV for test inputs. Each record should include an id, input_text, and optional metadata field.
> - Prompt length: we recommend keeping inputs under 1,024 tokens for the initial run — longer sequences are supported but increase latency variance.
>
> Access requirements:
> - S3 read access (IAM role or pre-signed URLs) OR a secure FTP endpoint.
> - If you plan to run evaluation in your VPC, we’ll coordinate a short IP allowlist for our onboarding agents; if you want Redwood-hosted evaluation, we’ll use secure upload links.
>
> Evaluation eval plan highlights we will track:
> - Latency distribution (p50/p90/p95), throughput at target concurrency, cost per effective token.
> - Qualitative checks against the prompt checklist (false positives, hallucination cases).
>
> I’ll attach a minimal runner script and a small schema example to the drive folder. Marcus signature
>
> Cheers,
> Marcus Lin
> Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
> marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
>
> [Quoted for context — Camila’s original MAP doc attached above]


-----Original Message-----

> - Marcus will post the minimal runner and schema. Rishi will provide target metric definitions by EOD Wed.
>

>
> Thanks all — looking forward to the kickoff.
>
> Camila
